overall_assessment: The adoption governance doctrine, deprecation policies, telemetry boundaries, and methodological non-negotiables codified in GOVERNANCE.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, and docs/sdk-and-adoption.md provide comprehensive, auditable, and scientifically sound operations. GOVERNANCE.md explicitly categorizes decisions into routine, contract, methodological, security/privacy, and external claim tiers, mandating reproducible machine-readable evidence receipts for high-risk determinations. Breaking changes and deprecation timelines are governed by consumer_contract_and_semver_gate, ensuring public API evolutions provide advance deprecation notices and backwards-compatible transition windows. Telemetry is disabled by default across all adoption materials (0 sampling, 0 retention), strictly forbidding the collection or export of query text, full text, API keys, or personal identifiers. Critically, methodological integrity is protected by non-negotiable repository rules in AGENTS.md: PRISMA-S is strictly maintained as a reporting contract rather than a conduct standard, and non-human agents are categorically forbidden from autonomous study exclusions or final screening determinations. All unit tests in tests/test_sdk_docs_adoption_governance.py asserting these governance constraints pass deterministically 100% network-free.
verified_invariants: PRISMA-S is reporting contract not conduct: AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/sdk-and-adoption.md codify that PRISMA-S governs reporting reproducibility, never search conduct
human-only screening authority: AGENTS.md categorically forbids autonomous study exclusions or final eligibility determinations by non-human agents
telemetry-free defaults: telemetry is disabled by default across all adoption workflows, with 0 sampling and 0 retention, forbidding query text, full text, or credentials export
transparent decision governance: GOVERNANCE.md defines routine, contract, methodological, security/privacy, and external claim decision classes with mandatory evidence receipts
deprecation and support policies: support tiers, deprecation notice periods, SemVer compatibility gates, and migration guidance are explicitly documented
deterministic verification: governance unit tests in tests/test_sdk_docs_adoption_governance.py pass 100% network-free

findings.description: Deprecation and support operations policies are fully codified in GOVERNANCE.md and docs/sdk-and-adoption.md; tracking deprecation notices and backwards-compatibility operations across at least one full release cycle remains an open operational gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate T35-G-DEPRECATION-LIFECYCLE-OBSERVATION until deprecation policy is exercised in production release cycles.

findings.description: Non-negotiable repository rules in AGENTS.md establish binding constraints on agents and developers alike, preventing methodological slippage or unauthorised autonomy.
findings.recommendation: Maintain unit test assertions enforcing AGENTS.md policy invariant strings in automated test suites.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Adoption operations, compatibility and deprecation policies in GOVERNANCE.md and README.md, non-negotiable PRISMA-S reporting contract adherence, and human-only study screening authority in AGENTS.md verified.

limitations: Governance, deprecation policies, and reporting contracts verified in documentation and unit tests; multi-cycle deprecation tracking and live support operations remain open operational gates.
